findings.finding: The required clinical wrap-up is declared no-material-claims even though it teaches and applies the sphere-volume formula, cubic volume scaling, the Pythagorean relation, a trigonometric ratio, inverse trigonometry, degree-radian conversion, and multiple quantitative conclusions. It has no source note, the repeated claims do not map to this scene in claims.json, and the sphere-volume claim is absent from the ledger. This is a false evidence declaration and leaves the scene's central mathematical content untraceable.
findings.resolution: Change the scene to claims-mapped, map every repeated material claim to scene-clinical-wrap-up, add a same-scene source note listing all supporting sources, and add an explicit claim with an exact supporting reference for the sphere-volume formula and any retained evidence-dependent clinical-model statements.

findings.finding: The opening and title present a spherical lesion calculation and a two-dimensional axial right triangle as connecting a scan to lesion sizing and a procedure-planning insertion angle. The closing disclaimer does not state the decisive model limits: an actual lesion need not be spherical or inferable from one radius, and two in-plane offsets cannot by themselves determine a safe three-dimensional needle trajectory. The current framing therefore invites an unsafe clinical overgeneralization beyond the mapped quantitative-foundations outcome.
findings.resolution: State before the task that the sphere and two-dimensional right triangle are stipulated mathematical idealizations that cannot estimate an actual lesion or plan a real procedure, and replace the title and procedure-planning language with explicitly non-clinical coordinate-geometry wording. If real clinical applicability is retained, support it with authoritative clinical-imaging evidence and define the relevant three-dimensional, anatomical, and procedural limits.

findings.finding: All eight claims are marked reviewed in a draft candidate whose lesson-level source confidence remains pending-review and which contains no frozen-candidate review artifacts. This pre-empts the independent academic determination and is inconsistent with the candidate-stage evidence state.
findings.resolution: Return all candidate claims to pending-review; only the authorized post-adjudication publication transition should mark retained claims reviewed.

findings.finding: Independent recomputation confirms both vertical contributions, total height 16.3229, scaled height 12.2422, area 81, exact angle 8π/45, component values, and the no-fit decision. The other five assessment keys and the numerical results in all scenes also agree with independent calculations within stated rounding.
findings.resolution: No change required to the checked arithmetic or answer keys.

limitations: The assigned scope prohibited reading site/, so the public review schema, graph artifact, quorum-policy file, and course terminology ledger were not inspected. Outcome existence and cross-lesson terminology continuity therefore could not be independently confirmed against those files.

The NASA sine-cosine-tangent subpage was unreachable through the available web fetcher. NASA's coordinate, area, volume, and Pythagorean pages and the NIST DLMF and SI sources were directly accessible and sufficient to verify the mathematical relations used.
This review assesses mathematical accuracy and evident clinical-model boundaries but does not claim specialist expertise in interventional radiology or procedural planning.
